title: 第一卷 南域篇 第3章 我只练纯阳第一卷 南域篇 第4章 柳灵与蛛妖
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“你说什么？！”谢玄叫了一声，“你要练纯阳？！”
白泽抹了把脸上的酒水，问：“如何？”
“你知道纯阳是练什么吗？”谢玄脸色怪异。
“知道啊。”白泽说，“之前我们路过河阳城，跟我们结伴同行的剑侠有告诉我，纯阳心法，是道门绝学，练出来纯阳真气，至阳至刚，摧枯拉朽！”
“那小子算个狗屁的剑侠，一辈子也就那点成就了，破至尊入超凡遥遥无期！”谢玄骂了一声，“纯阳心法，练的是至阳道气，这要求修行者在功法大成之前，必须一点元阳都不能泄露。”
“那又如何？”白泽问。
“倒也不如何。”谢玄说，“只是……你还记得我们程村偷看小茉莉洗澡吗？”
白泽当然记得，当时他还大叫一声，抓着自己的小兄弟质问谢玄，为啥小茉莉没有那玩意，说既然她没有，他也不要了。
“练纯阳，以后你就不能偷看漂亮女孩洗澡啦！”谢玄满脸凝重地告诉白泽，“不然，你心起欲念，会导致纯阳真气燥乱，轻则吐血三升，重则魂归仙山！”
“你不会锁阳之法？”白泽问，“锁阳不就好啦，真元就不会暴动啊。”
“这也是那半吊子剑侠告诉你的？”谢玄问。
“是啊。”白泽点头。
“……他奶奶的欧阳木，再让道爷碰到，我非弄死你！”谢玄破口大骂，咬牙切齿。
他茕茕孑立大半生，好不容易捡了个便宜徒弟，资质还算可以，原本打算传授毕生绝学，没想到被半路杀来的半吊子剑侠洗了脑，非要练什么狗屁纯阳！
“退一步说啊，你就是练了纯阳，可日后你遇见心动的姑娘，你却不能行房，如何是好？”谢玄试图把白泽从纯阳的歪路上拉回来，“寻常女修，可受不了你纯阳真气的冲击，搞不好能把对方克死……”
“没事。”白泽摆摆手，“欧阳跟我说了，修了纯阳，以后就得找纯阴女修双修。大不了我去找道门圣女呗。”
找圣女双修。
谢玄只觉得脑门有根筋断了，他一巴掌按在床上，将木板床一角按得粉碎。
“欧阳木，老子要弄死你！”谢玄只想一把将那剑侠的剑器掰成两半，然后一脚将他踹得半身不遂！
“罢了罢了。”谢玄叹了口气，“纯阳就纯阳吧，好在纯阳心法道门三柱都有涉猎。徒儿啊，你要修纯阳为师没意见，可道门绝学颇多，纯阳练气，可你打算主修道气，还是道心，还是道意？”

道门上乘高手，那些传说中的仙人，无一不是将道门绝学融会贯通的。
可修道一途，可谓艰难。
三者同修，对后来人来说，太难了。
于是道门内部产生分裂。
道仙创道门以来，门下弟子颇多。可大多数一个弟子只学到了道仙一门绝学，只有他的十三关门弟子得他真传。
十三弟子各自开山，传授道统，后来成为道门十三绝。时如流水，白云苍狗，千百年后，道门十三绝只剩下三绝，被九州世人称为道门三柱。
传承至今，要想光复当年道仙尚在时道门的辉煌，已经是不可能。
如今的道门，虽是九州三正道之一，可道门的修道一途，已经被支离破碎。
虽然道门弟子都以练气为起点修道，可从他们修道开始，也要决定，今后是主修道气，还是辅修道气、主修道心，或者辅修道气、主修道意。
“为师当年修的是道心，虽然你要修的《纯阳真经》在心修方面不如我修的《太乙紫薇录》，可你要是想，为师的‘太乙神剑’你也不是不能习得……”谢玄说。
“我要修道意。”白泽打断谢玄的话，一脸认真，“道门术法，道法自然，飞星摘月，移山平海，这是我心目中的大道！”
谢玄叹了口气，说：“你可要知道，虽道门三柱有异曲同工之处，可为师年少时毕竟主修道心，虽然对另外两道也有所涉猎，可毕竟非我证道之途，我也说不上做到玄奇。”
白泽点头。
“指点你，眼下是绰绰有余，可未来，可需要你自己独闯天道。”谢玄难得正经，语气凝重。
“师傅当年师承师祖，难道是全靠师祖教诲吗？”白泽倒是洒脱，“难道每个人自己的证道之路，不都是他自己走出来的吗？”
谢玄一怔，愣愣出神。
半晌，哈哈大笑，拍了拍白泽的肩膀，“后生可畏！倒是为师狭隘了！只想着衣钵有人传承，却失了天道一途，本来就当独闯之理！你很好！”
如此年纪，竟然有这等通透的感悟，果真不愧是先天道胎！
谢玄顿了顿，高深莫测地问：“徒儿，为师不可否认你在道意一途上的无上天赋，为师的气运山河——你学到了几分？”
“未曾有练气、运气之法，不曾实践。”白泽说，双眼灿若星辰，“可多次观摩师尊行此术，约摸知晓三分。若有《纯阳真经》，当可牛刀小试！”
content_en:
"What did you say?!" Xie Xuan shouted, "You want to practice Chunyang?!"
Bai Ze wiped the drink from his face and asked, "How is it?"
"Do you know what Chunyang practices?" Xie Xuan looked strange.
"I know." Bai Ze said, "We passed by Heyang City before, and the swordsman who was traveling with us told me that the Pure Yang Mind Technique is a Taoist secret. The pure Yang Qi can be practiced to be the most powerful and powerful, and it can destroy everything!"
"That kid is a shit swordsman. He has only achieved this little achievement in his life. He has no chance of breaking through the supreme realm and entering the extraordinary world!"
"So what?" Bai Ze asked.
"It's not that bad." Xie Xuan said, "It's just...do you remember our Cheng Cun peeking at little Jasmine taking a bath?"
Of course Bai Ze remembered it. He yelled at that time, grabbed his little brother and asked Xie Xuan why little Jasmine didn't have that thing, saying that since she didn't have it, he didn't want it either.
"Practice Chunyang, and you won't be able to peek at beautiful girls bathing in the future!" Xie Xuan told Bai Ze with a solemn face, "Otherwise, if you have lust in your heart, it will cause Chunyang's true energy to become dry and chaotic, which can range from vomiting three liters of blood to returning to the fairy mountain!"
"You don't know how to use Cynomorium Cynomorium?" Bai Ze asked, "It's better if you don't use Cynomorium Cynomorium, and the true energy won't riot."
"Is this what that half-assed swordsman told you?" Xie Xuan asked.
"Yes." Bai Ze nodded.
"...His grandma's Ouyang Mu, if you let Master Dao touch it again, I will kill you!" Xie Xuan cursed loudly, gritting his teeth.
He had been alone for most of his life, and finally picked up a cheap apprentice with decent qualifications. He originally planned to teach his lifelong skills, but he was brainwashed by a half-hearted swordsman who killed him on the way and insisted on practicing some bullshit Chunyang!
"To say the least, you have practiced pure yang, but in the future you meet a girl who is attracted to you, but you can't have sex. What should you do?"
"It's okay." Bai Ze waved his hand, "Ouyang told me that after cultivating pure yang, you will have to find a pure yin girl to practice double cultivation. In the worst case, I will find a Taoist saint."
Find a saint to practice double cultivation.
Xie Xuan only felt that a tendon in his forehead was broken. He pressed his palm on the bed, crushing a corner of the wooden bed to pieces.
"Ouyang Mu, I'm going to kill you!" Xie Xuan just wanted to break the swordsman's sword in half, and then kick him until he was paralyzed!
"That's all." Xie Xuan sighed, "Let Chunyang be pure Yang. Fortunately, all three pillars of Chunyang Heart Method are involved. Disciple, I have no objection to you wanting to practice Chunyang as a teacher, but there are many secrets in the Taoist sect. Chunyang Qi training, but do you plan to focus on Tao Qi, Tao Heart, or Tao Intention?"
The best masters of the Tao sect, the legendary immortals, all have mastered the Tao sect's secret knowledge.
But the path to Taoism can be described as difficult.
The three practices are too difficult for those who come after us.
As a result, a split occurred within the Taoist sect.
Since Tao Xian founded the Taoist sect, he has many disciples. But most of the disciples only learned one Taoist secret, and only his disciples of the Thirteen Gates learned his true teachings.
The thirteen disciples each founded a mountain and taught Taoism, and later became the Thirteen Jue of Taoism. Time is like running water, white clouds are like a dog, thousands of years later, only three of the thirteen skills of the Tao Sect are left, and they are called the Three Pillars of the Tao Sect by the people of Kyushu.
It has been passed down to this day, and it is no longer possible to regain the glory of the Dao Sect when the Dao Immortal was still there.
Although the current Dao Sect is one of the Three True Paths of Kyushu, its path of cultivation has been fragmented.
Although Taoist disciples all start practicing Taoism with Qi training, they must also decide from the beginning of their Taoism practice whether they will focus on Tao Qi, secondary Qi and Tao heart, or secondary Qi and Tao mind.
"When I was a teacher, I cultivated Taoist mind. Although you have to cultivateThe "Chun Yang Zhen Jing" I studied is not as good as the "Taiyi Ziwei Lu" I studied in terms of mental cultivation, but if you think about it, you can't learn the 'Taiyi Divine Sword' as my teacher..." Xie Xuan said.
"I want to practice Taoism. "Bai Ze interrupted Xie Xuan's words with a serious look on his face, "Taoist magic, Taoism and nature, flying stars picking up the moon, moving mountains and leveling the sea, this is the Tao in my mind! "
Xie Xuan sighed and said: "You have to know that although the three pillars of the Taoist sect have different approaches but the same purpose, my master focused on cultivating the Taoist heart when I was young. Although I have also dabbled in the other two Taoists, after all, it is not my path to enlightenment, and I cannot say that I have achieved mysteries. "
Bai Ze nodded.
"Guiding you is more than enough for now, but in the future, you will need to explore the way of heaven on your own. "Xie Xuan was rarely serious and his tone was solemn.
"Master, when he learned from his master, did he rely entirely on his teachings? Bai Ze was free and easy, "Isn't it true that everyone's own path to enlightenment is taken by themselves?" "
Xie Xuan was startled and lost his mind.
After a while, he laughed loudly and patted Bai Ze on the shoulder, "Young people are scary! That’s a very narrow-minded approach to being a teacher! He only wanted to have someone to pass on the mantle, but he lost his way to heaven. He was supposed to be alone! You are fine! "
At such a young age, to have such a clear understanding is indeed worthy of being an innate Taoist!
Xie Xuan paused and asked enigmatically: "Disciple, as a teacher, it is undeniable that you have supreme talent in the way of Taoism, and as a teacher, you have great luck - how much have you learned? "
“There has never been a way to train Qi or luck, and it has never been practiced. Bai Ze said, his eyes as bright as stars, "I have watched the master perform this technique many times, and I know about it by touch." If there is a "Chun Yang Zhen Jing", you should be able to give it a try! "
